baseline.method: Original PALMA hybrid lambda0.01, full29 realQGC support bands

metric_definitions.relative_l2: norm(predicted-reference)/norm(reference), separately each of29 bands, worst reported
metric_definitions.cosine: uncentered cosine each band, minimum reported
metric_definitions.ball_ratio: norm(K predicted-y)/eta, separately each band, maximum reported

provenance: Frozen before local extraction in private palma_frozen_criteria.json; nonzero numerical limits for a method reference, plus independent public observation consistency. No truth exists.
v2_definition: Per-band scaled convex hybrid regularizer must be no greater than the independently validated feasible standard value plus relative1e-8; retain full attenuation ball and nonnegativity limits. No hidden map matching or capped PPXA trajectory is required.
